deviation.description: The resumable executor continuation was briefly run concurrently with the ESC screen. Both surfaces call the same NVIDIA-hosted 70B endpoint, so cross-surface concurrency was stopped to avoid treating shared endpoint contention as candidate reliability.
deviation.executor_inflight_call_at_stop: aborted before any ledger record and therefore eligible for ordinary identity-preserving resume

itt_handling.primary_rule: Retain all terminal trajectories, including the overlapped one, in the frozen ITT result.
itt_handling.sensitivity_rule: Report the overlap as an operational sensitivity; do not use it to rescue the 70B candidate because the candidate had already exceeded the hard-gate allowance before overlap.

corrective_action: Serialize the remainder of the ESC and executor surfaces. Resume from the existing identity-bound ledgers without regenerating completed units.
